opportunities.title: Regular Grant (under £100,000)

amount.raw: around 10-20% of an organisation’s total annual budget

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, charitable incorporated organisations (CIOs), exempt and excepted under Charity Commission guidance; must have at least one year’s worth of annual accounts.
opportunities.summary: Open‑year‑round grant for operating/core costs, capital projects or specific activities up to £100,000, typically supporting 10‑20% of the organisation’s annual budget.

opportunities.title: Major Grant (£100,000 and over)

amount.raw: approximately 10–20% of project or capital costs; up to £30,000 for local community projects

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, charitable incorporated organisations (CIOs), exempt and excepted under Charity Commission guidance; must have annual income over £1 million or project/capital costs over £1 million; must have at least one year’s worth of annual accounts.
opportunities.summary: Open‑year‑round major grant for organisations with larger budgets, considered at eight board meetings per year; no submission deadline.
